name: latex-studio
description: A lightweight local LaTeX workspace: edit, compile, preview PDF in the browser.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @latex-studio/shared build && pnpm --filter @latex-studio/latex-parser build && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @latex-studio/server dev" "pnpm --filter @latex-studio/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @latex-studio/shared build && pnpm --filter @latex-studio/latex-parser build && pnpm --filter @latex-studio/web build && pnpm --filter @latex-studio/server build
scripts.test:stress: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs LS_STRESS=1 -- pnpm --filter @latex-studio/server exec vitest run test/performance.stress.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @latex-studio/shared build && pnpm --filter @latex-studio/latex-parser build && pnpm --filter @latex-studio/web build && pnpm --filter @latex-studio/server build && playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:latex: pnpm --filter @latex-studio/shared build && pnpm --filter @latex-studio/latex-parser build && pnpm --filter @latex-studio/web build && pnpm --filter @latex-studio/server build && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs E2E_HAS_LATEX=1 -- playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.ts
